pages.title: Magic Earns Its Keep
pages.text: Use your spells to damage a hostile creature, heal missing health, and relocate yourself successfully.

pages.title: Magic Earns Its Keep
pages.text: Show three genuinely different uses for your magic; an accessory choice rewards a versatile build.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use any supported native spell for each role, in any order. Healing must restore health; relocation must move you through native spell logic. Ordinary food, melee and vanilla portals do not substitute.
